Read the proposed FloraTend free and Premium model while store configuration is in development.

In development. App availability, supported devices, translations and Premium purchasing await release verification.

A proposed free tier

The planned free tier includes up to five plants, manual plant entry, basic care reminders and basic growth notes.

A proposed one-time unlock

FloraTend Premium is planned to add unlimited plants and advanced care, journal, insights and export features. Products and regional pricing are not final.

Store pricing at purchase

An available release will show the price supplied by Amazon for your marketplace. There is no checkout on this website, and no purchase is currently offered here.
